API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS)NSS Feeds Resource Test Cloud NSS Connectivity
NSS Feeds Resource Test Cloud NSS Connectivity
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/nssFeeds/testConnectivity/:feedId

Tests the connectivity of cloud NSS feed based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
feedId
int32
REQUIRED

Unique identifier for the cloud NSS feed

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
siemType
string

Cloud NSS SIEM type

Possible values: [SPLUNK, SUMO_LOGIC, DEVO, OTHER, AZURE_SENTINEL, S3]

maxBatchSize
int32

The maximum batch size in KB

connectionURL
string

The HTTPS URL of the SIEM log collection API endpoint

authenticationToken
string

The authentication token value

connectionHeaders
string[]

The HTTP Connection headers

lastSuccessFullTest
int32

The timestamp of the last successful test. Value is in Unix time

testConnectivityStatus
string

The connectivity test status

testConnectivityCode
int32

The code from the last test

base64EncodedCertificate
string

Base64-encoded certificate

nssType
string

NSS type

Possible values: [NONE, SOFTWARE_AA_FLAG, NSS_FOR_WEB, NSS_FOR_FIREWALL, VZEN, VZEN_SME, VZEN_SMLB, PINNED_NSS, MD5_CAPABLE, ADP, ZIRSVR]

clientId
string

Client ID applicable when SIEM type is set to S3 or Azure Sentinel

clientSecret
string

Client secret applicable when SIEM type is set to S3 or Azure Sentinel

authenticationUrl
string

Authentication URL applicable when SIEM type is set to Azure Sentinel

grantType
string

Grant type applicable when SIEM type is set to Azure Sentinel

scope
string

Scope applicable when SIEM type is set to Azure Sentinel

oauthAuthentication
boolean

A Boolean value indicating whether OAuth 2.0 authentication is enabled or not
